name: gpu-cron
title: Natural language to cron
description: Plain English to a 5-field cron expression, by gpu-cron (an 89 KB WebGPU model, no CPU fallback): gpuCronAvailable asks first without downloading anything on a browser with no WebGPU, parseCronText proposes an expression, and useCronParse is the debounced React side CronEditor uses.
